summary.text: One Finger Flow Shark is an immemorial desolate beast that hides in the river of time and carries time path Immortal Gu.

claims.text: Shark Demon transmits that the small shark is a one finger flow shark. Ordinary Gu Immortals may not know it, but time path Gu Immortals know the mnemonic: one finger flow shark, an instance of brilliance; flowing water and clear voice, heaven is impartial. It normally hides in the river of time. Shark Demon and Su Bai Man found its tracks by chance, requested the sea area from Zombie Alliance, and built shark sea there. Blazing Heaven Demoness names their costly enslavement path move Lower Controls Higher, from Hundred and Eighty Slaves, as the tool meant to subdue it. Shark Demon admits that plan but says his enslavement path attainment and Immortal Gu were insufficient, so he had not succeeded. The beast is not only an immemorial desolate beast; it also contains several time path Immortal Gu, and their aura overflows without concealment.
It is small, resembling a silver firefly when it pounces, and later shoots like a silver arrow. Its small body still holds immemorial desolate beast brute strength.

When it clashes with Blazing Heaven Demoness’s small fire bird, both seem to turn from extreme speed to stillness. Tai Bai Yun Sheng judges a time path Immortal Gu slowed time in range without changing their actual speed. When the shark pokes the fire bird, a second Immortal Gu aura changes, then the fire bird detonates.

Blazing Heaven Demoness later names three time path Immortal Gu on it: one slows time, one speeds time, and one changes the perception of time. As a time path desolate beast it is less restricted by its own slow-time effect. It pierces her chest and forehead using those methods, then is pacified and dives away. Fang Yuan judges that Shark Demon’s influence over it is already remarkable, and that given time, Shark Demon might control the beast and its three Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan later treats one finger flow shark as rank eight battle strength with three time path Immortal Gu, too strong for his star soul battlefield alone, and notes that dealing with it also means fighting Shark Demon and Su Bai Man.
In a prior-life summary he recalls Blazing Heaven Demoness defeating that immemorial desolate beast.
Another Eastern Sea observer later praises Shark Demon and Su Bai Man for restraining a rank eight level one finger flow shark with enslavement path methods.
